keyword: what is the purpose of artemis 2

verifications.claim: Artemis II is a 10-day crewed flight test.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The 10-day Artemis II mission will fly" (R5); "10-day mission" (R2, R6, R8, R9, R10)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly describe it as a 10-day crewed test flight, though R3 notes precisely 9 days 1 hour.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate NASA's Orion spacecraft in deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "testing the Orion spacecraft" (R1); "validate the Orion spacecraft's systems" (R3); "test flight of... the Orion spacecraft" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state validation/testing of Orion in deep space context.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate SLS rocket in deep space.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "first crewed flight of the Space Launch System (SLS)" (R3); SLS launches but separates early (R4, R5)
verifications.reasoning: SLS is tested on ascent, not in deep space; Orion is the deep space vehicle.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate life-support systems in deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "check that the spacecraft can safely make the journey and keep its crew alive" (R2); "flight test Orion’s life-support systems with astronauts on board" (R5, R6)

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "first crewed trip around the moon in more than 50 years" (R1); "first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972" (R3)

verifications.claim: Artemis II aims to fly four astronauts around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "send four astronauts aboard the Orion spacecraft" around moon (R1); "four astronauts toward space... around the moon" (R2)

verifications.claim: Artemis II tests systems for future lunar landings and eventual Mars missions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "lay the groundwork for future exploration... to Mars" (R1); "clear a path for... new lunar landing... journeys farther out" (R2)

verifications.claim: Key objectives of the Artemis II mission include testing the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "test Orion’s life-support systems with astronauts on board" (R5); "life support systems for the first time with crew" (R10)

verifications.claim: Key objectives of the Artemis II mission include testing the Orion spacecraft's environmental control systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "life-support systems" includes environmental control (R2, R5)
verifications.reasoning: Environmental control is part of life-support, but not separately specified.

verifications.claim: Key objectives of the Artemis II mission include testing the Orion spacecraft's navigation systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Guidance, navigation, and communications" (R8); navigation in deep space (R3)

verifications.claim: Artemis II sends four astronauts on a journey around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "send four astronauts... around the moon" (R1)

verifications.claim: The four astronauts include the first woman to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Ms. Koch of NASA will be the first woman to do so" (R2); "Christina Koch the first woman" (R3)

verifications.claim: The four astronauts include the first person of color to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mr. Glover... first Black man to venture into deep space" (R2); "Victor Glover... first person of color" (R3)

verifications.claim: The four astronauts include the first Canadian to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mr. Hansen... first person on a moon mission who is not an American" (R2); "Jeremy Hansen the first non-U.S. citizen" (R3)

verifications.claim: Artemis II passes roughly 4,700 miles beyond the Moon.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "about 4,000 miles above the surface" (R2); "4,067 mi" (R3); "over 4,000 miles beyond the Moon" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources say ~4,000-4,067 mi; 4,700 is roughly close but not exact.

verifications.claim: Artemis II aims to fly humans farther into space than ever before.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "farthest that any humans have traveled from Earth" (R2); "set the record for human distance from Earth" (R3)

verifications.claim: Artemis II serves as a test to prepare for Artemis III.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "data will directly inform... Artemis III" (R8); preparing for Artemis III (R6)

verifications.claim: Artemis II serves as a test to prepare for Artemis IV.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "test flight supporting the Artemis IV mission to return humans to the lunar surface" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: R3 mentions IV specifically, but generally for future missions.

verifications.claim: Artemis II serves as a test to prepare for future missions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "lay the groundwork for future exploration" (R1)

verifications.claim: Artemis III, IV, and future missions will land humans back on the lunar surface.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Artemis IV mission to return humans to the lunar surface" (R3); general program for landings
verifications.reasoning: R3 supports IV landing; program aims for landings.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Commander Reid Wiseman.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "commander Reid Wiseman" (R2, R3)

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Pilot Victor Glover.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Pilot Victor Glover" (R1, R5)

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Christina Koch.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Christina Koch" mission specialist (R2, R3)

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Jeremy Hansen" mission specialist (R2, R3)
